minutes.headline: Planning Board approved a stormwater permit and site plan for an earth removal project at 1325 Mass Ave, with a berm.
minutes.summary: Held remotely by Zoom during COVID-19, the board approved an ANR plan for 176 Elmwood Road and held concurrent stormwater permit and site plan hearings for 1325 Massachusetts Avenue. After neighbors raised dust and noise concerns, the applicant agreed to a four to six foot earthen berm, the board waived the monitoring well requirement, and both permits were approved with conditions. The board also postponed the stormwater bylaw discussion, cancelled the April 27 meeting, and discussed Chapter land parcels.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at the start; none seen.
Abutter asked whether the earth removal volume had changed from the 25,000 cubic yards, asked about timber clearing and truck loads, and asked for a higher berm.
Abutter said he has no buffer from the project and worried about dust, wetlands, and catch basin maintenance.
Abutters asked for a higher berm and discussed its length and whether it should be planted.
Abutter asked if anything could buffer his property from the project.

votes.motion: Approve the ANR plan for 176 Elmwood Road.
Close the site plan approval hearing.
Approve the stormwater permit at 1325 Mass Ave, with sediment forebay maintenance added to the O&M plan and the installed monitoring well removed.
Approve the site plan with a condition for a four to six foot seeded earthen berm in lieu of plantings.

decisions.decision: Stormwater bylaw discussion deferred; the consultant may be invited to a later meeting.
The April 27 meeting is cancelled; the next meeting is advertised for May 11.
The board will not make a recommendation on the Historical Commission article unless asked again.
The board waived the stormwater handbook monitoring well requirement for this project under the bylaw waiver provision.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the stormwater permit for the earth removal project at 1325 Mass Ave, with sediment forebay maintenance added to the O&M plan and the installed monitoring well removed.
The board approved the site plan with a condition for a four to six foot seeded earthen berm in place of plantings.
The board waived the stormwater handbook monitoring well requirement for this project under the bylaw waiver provision.
The board approved the ANR plan for 176 Elmwood Road.
The stormwater bylaw discussion was deferred, and the April 27 meeting was cancelled, with the next meeting advertised for May 11.

why_it_matters: Abutters to the 1325 Mass Ave earth removal site raised dust, noise and drainage concerns, and the approved conditions, a berm and a maintenance plan, are the mechanisms that will govern those effects.
Deferring the stormwater bylaw discussion leaves the town's stormwater rules unchanged for now, and the waiver used here shows how those rules can be relaxed project by project.
watch_next: The next Planning Board meeting, advertised for May 11, and whether the stormwater bylaw discussion returns with the consultant.
